about.title: A warmer welcome to Kabul
about.intro: Manzil helps travelers discover places to stay and helps local property owners introduce what makes their place special.

sections.title: A place for every journey
sections.body: Explore hotels, hostels, guesthouses, apartments and dormitories across Kabul. Compare location, photos, available rooms and prices before choosing your stay.

sections.title: Local languages, clearer choices
sections.body: Use Manzil in English, Dari or Pashto. Our marketplace brings property information into one place so you can make a more informed choice.

sections.title: What verification means
sections.body: A verified badge indicates that a property has completed Manzil’s review process. Read the listing, policies and guest feedback as well; verification does not guarantee every part of a stay.

sections.title: For property owners
sections.body: Want to list your property? Open “List your property” and follow the steps to create a Provider account, add rooms and submit your listing for review.

help.title: A little help for your journey
help.intro: Find answers before you book, while preparing for your stay, or when managing a reservation.

sections.title: How do I find a stay?
sections.body: Search by neighborhood or property name. Filter by property type, rating and verification, then open a listing to compare photos, rooms, prices and policies. The map helps you explore the location.

sections.title: How do reservations work?
sections.body: Choose an available room, enter your dates and guest details, review the total, and confirm while signed in. Follow the payment method shown during booking. You can find your reservation in My account → My reservations.

sections.title: Can I cancel a reservation?
sections.body: Open My reservations to see whether cancellation is available. Review the property’s cancellation policy before cancelling. Fees and refund eligibility depend on the conditions of your reservation.

sections.title: Need help with arrival or an account?
sections.body: For directions, check-in or on-site needs, use the contact details on your property listing or booking confirmation. For an account issue, visit Contact and include the information listed there. Never share your password or a one-time code.

contact.title: Let’s find the right help
contact.intro: Start with your property for stay-related questions, or prepare your booking details for an account or marketplace issue.

sections.title: Contact your property
sections.body: For directions, arrival times, room requests, lost items or a problem during your stay, use the property contact information in your booking confirmation. Your property is best placed to answer questions about its rooms and services.

sections.title: Account and booking questions
sections.body: Review Help and My reservations first. Keep your reservation reference, property name, travel dates and a short description of the issue ready. Do not include your password, payment card details or verification codes.

sections.title: Property owners
sections.body: Use Manzil Provider for property details, room management and onboarding. Start from “List your property” on the marketplace to reach the Provider application.

sections.title: Contact marketplace support
sections.body: For account or marketplace questions, email our support team using the link below. Include your reservation reference if relevant, a short description of the issue, and the best way to reach you. Never send passwords or verification codes.

terms.title: Terms of using Manzil
terms.intro: These terms describe use of the marketplace. Read the property’s own booking and stay conditions before confirming a reservation.

sections.title: Your account and information
sections.body: Provide accurate contact and guest details and keep your account credentials private. Use the marketplace responsibly and do not submit fraudulent reservations, misleading content or information you do not have permission to share.

sections.title: Listings and reservations
sections.body: Property owners supply their listing details, room availability, prices and stay policies. Review these details and the total shown before confirming. A verified badge reflects a review process and is not a guarantee of every amenity or experience.

sections.title: Payments, changes and cancellation
sections.body: Follow the payment terms presented during booking. Changes, cancellation fees and refunds depend on the property policy and reservation conditions. Do not assume free cancellation or a refund unless it is expressly included in your booking.

sections.title: Questions and applicable rights
sections.body: Raise stay-related concerns with the property and retain your booking records. These terms do not remove rights that cannot be excluded under applicable law. If published terms change, review the version available when making a new reservation.

privacy.title: Your information, handled with care
privacy.intro: Learn what information is used to provide accounts, property discovery and reservations on Manzil.

sections.title: Information you provide
sections.body: Account and booking forms ask for information such as your name, email, phone number, language preference, travel dates and guest details. Property owners provide listing information and photos. Submit only information needed for your request.

sections.title: How information is used
sections.body: Information is used to authenticate your account, create and manage reservations, communicate booking details, and operate the marketplace. Relevant guest and reservation details are shared with the booked property so it can arrange your stay.

sections.title: Browser storage and maps
sections.body: Manzil uses browser storage for your sign-in session and language preference. Saved stays are held in the current app session. The interactive map requests tiles from OpenStreetMap by default; that map service receives network information such as your IP address and requested map area. Clearing browser storage removes locally stored preferences and sessions.

sections.title: Your choices and questions
sections.body: You can change your profile and language in My account and manage locally saved stays. For questions about account information, correction or deletion, review the Contact page for available contact channels. Keep your password and verification codes private.

cancellation-policy.title: Plans change. Know your options.
cancellation-policy.intro: Cancellation conditions are set by each property. Check your specific reservation before making a change.

sections.title: Before you book
sections.body: Read the property’s policies, cancellation deadline and payment terms. There is no single free-cancellation window for every stay on Manzil. Monthly stays, dormitory beds and special rates may have different conditions.

sections.title: How to cancel
sections.body: Sign in and open My account → My reservations. If a cancellation action is available, review your booking conditions before using it. For changes or a cancellation you cannot complete online, contact the property through your booking confirmation.

sections.title: Charges and refunds
sections.body: Late cancellations and no-shows may incur charges under the property’s policy. Refund eligibility, amount and timing depend on your reservation, the property and the payment method. Cancelling a reservation does not by itself guarantee or initiate a refund.

sections.title: Keep your confirmation
sections.body: Keep your original reservation and any cancellation confirmation. If you have a question about a charge, contact the property with your reservation reference and relevant dates.
